en: See, I'm the opposite. I go to cabaret clubs when I'm not in the mood for drinking alone.
I've got some friends who say they don't wanna eat by themselves.
Like, they'll call up anyone and everyone on the phone just to find a dining companion.
I suppose for some people, mealtime isn't just about eating, but also about getting together and having good conversation.
I always ate with my family.
Family? Aren't ya single, Kiryu-san?
Back in Okinawa, I ran an orphanage and looked after some children. They were my family.
Wow, I had no idea! So then did y'take the kids out with you to family restaurants?
We didn't usually have the money for that, so most days I cooked for everyone. But it was fun to splurge sometimes and eat out.
That reminds me of my dad. I didn't have a mom growin' up, and so on days off, he'd take me out someplace nice.
That's nice. In the end, the best thing is for a family to come together for a meal.
Whew, I'm stuffed!
(I should probably be on my way.)
Hey, Uncle Kaz? I'm hungry for some <Color:8>Miso Motsunabe<Color:Default>.
(Haruka wants to have some <Color:8>Miso Motsunabe<Color:Default>.)
I guess we'll have to get <Color:8>Miso Motsunabe<Color:Default> some other time, then.
(What should I look at?)
(<Color:8>Pickled Motsu<Color:Default>, huh? I'd like to try that.)
(The <Color:8>Motsuyaki<Color:Default> looks pretty good.)
(I've already been in here. I should pick another place.)
(La Seine? Looks like this is a cabaret club. I think Uncle Kaz might frequent this place.)
(This is La Seine, a cabaret club. But I'm not really in the mood for this sort of thing tonight. Maybe some other time.)
(Riku's in Kamurocho right now. Maybe she'll be back once Elise makes its comeback. Until then, I don't have any reason to be here.)
(I convinced Riku to go back to Tokyo with me. Once we get back to Kamurocho, we should go to Elise.)
(Oh, that's right. Akiyama wanted new girls for his club lineup. Maybe I should talk to Riku.)
(So, this is La Seine. I can't just barge in, though. I should hit up an adult entertainment info booth first.)
(La Seine, a cabaret club. As fun as it might be, this isn't the time.)
(La Seine? Hm, a cabaret club. It'd be a waste of time for me to go to a bunch of different clubs. Gotta focus on just one place.)
(A cabaret club, La Seine. Man, I'd love to check it out, but I'd better not.)
(La Seine? Looks like this is a cabaret club. I think Uncle Kaz might have been here.)
(Takasugi-san's still around. I can't go home.)
(Takasugi-san might still be around. Wouldn't want to run into him.)

(Crap. Of course I'd oversleep on the day of the interview.
Better get my ass over to Futo Momo, stat.)

(Let's see, that club's on Icho Street... Yikes, that's
actually pretty far. I really do need to haul ass.)
I'm gonna get your ass for this! Count on it!
(Man, what a rotten day. Know what? I'm just gonna go home.)
Well, if it ain't the sultan of smut himself.
You're... the security company guy? Ono-san, was it?
Yeah, and thanks to your bullshit, I got a fuckin' hole through my cheek!
Hope you're happy, jackass!
Oogh, sounds awful. Does juice leak out when you drink it?
Fuck you!
You have no idea what kinda stress your antics caused me!
Maybe not, but may I suggest you visit the batting center?
It'd be the perfect place to blow off all that steam.
Are you fuckin' with me!?
I wouldn't want to.
You <Italic>are</Italic> fuckin' with me!
Look, do you really have the right to blame me?
Excuse me!?
You knew right from the start that bat was a fake, didn't you?
I don't know what you're talkin' about!
Wow, can you be more obvious?
You swapped the real thing with a fake that was cracked to begin with, then made Toriyama-san carry it, didn't you?
If you don't quit spouting that bullshit, I'm gonna shut you up permanently!
Let me ask you something. How many hundreds of broken bats do you think I've seen?
I know for a fact not one of them would crack just by dropping it.

Were you not just trying to get Toriyama-san to pay for the
damages while keeping the real thing hidden for yourself?
If ya figured out that much... I'll just have to make ya disappear!
Oh? You're not gonna rally your Nagoya Family friends?
This shit's personal, dickhead!
The only thing that can soothe my aching cheek... is to hear you scream in pain!
Hey. Heard you just got paid.
Ushijima-san...
Drop by for a drink and settle your tab.
The thing is...
Don't tell me you blew it already? Well screw me sideways.
In any case, I made that miso stew you like today. Just come on over.
Bless you, Ushijima-san!
I'll save you a seat. Don't dawdle now.
(Now that's a true friend! Better mosey on over to Ushijima-san's place before the stew gets cold. He's on Kumano Boulevard.)
It hurts... all over...
Hey, can I go now? I was going pretty easy on you, so you shouldn't be <Italic>that</Italic> messed up.
Urk... Damn you!

(Hm. Nope. Everything's still functioning. But man, now I'm
even more hungry...)
(Let's just forget that little distraction and get over to the batting center.)
Hey, are you Shinada? That sleazy journalist guy?
Yup, that would be me.
So you're the one who wrote up a thing about Koko⑬I mean, Melon?
Oh, you must be referring to "Magical Mystery Melons" from Nightlife Magazine. Yeah, that was what, two issues ago? One of my finest exposés, if I do say so myself!
Gotta hand it to the girl for picking such a ripe name. It says in one word what you're about to put your hands on.
They're soft, they're succulent, they jiggle to the touch. Freshest of the season by far.
You shut your filthy mouth!
That gonzo article of yours was on <Italic>my</Italic> girl! You wanna explain why you're messin' with another man's woman!?
Did Melon-chan maybe not tell you... she's a working girl?
Ooh, and she still okayed my intrusion into her quarters⑬<Italic>now</Italic> I see why you're mad. You've got a naughty little Melon on your hands!
Real talk, though, this is between you and her. So can you not go dragging me into this?
Don't pretend you're the victim! I'll make you bleed for this!
(Hm? It's from the editorial office.)
Hey, it's Shinada. What's the dealio?
It's about that manuscript you turned in. Your handwriting's atrocious!

Even some of the key points are completely illegible.
So I thought I'd go over them with you, if that's okay.

Oh, sure. And sorry, I was kind of in a rush today. Anyway.
Where should we start?
Uh... Let's see. How about the name of the club you visited?
That's Club Futo Momo.
Oh, this says Futo Momo? The letters are all jumbled up.
That's Club Futa Mata.
Huh? Really? This is a "t" and not an "m"?
Well, you're the reporter, Shinada-san. I'm taking your word for it.
That's Club Furi Sode.
Huh? Furisode? As in the kimono? What, are they some kind of fetish club?
Okay, there's one more. What's the name of the girl you reviewed?
Oh come on now, you should know that one. It's Milky-chan.

Hey, we're short-staffed as it is! If someone weren't so
late all the time, or didn't have such shoddy handwriting⑬
Oops, you're right. I deserved that. Hahaha. No really, my bad.
It's Michiru-chan. We ran features on her before⑬you should remember her.
Huh? You're sure that's right? The name does look familiar, but...

Well, you're the one who covered her all those times.
I suppose you wouldn't get it wrong. Okay, roger that.
It's Mikly-chan. She's my golden girl, my star child, my eternal sunshine! Get it right, dude.
Huh? You mean it's Mikly and not Milky? Oh, so I guess you got these letters reversed.
I was thinking this has to be Milky, but you're saying it's Mikly. Roger that.
That about does it. Sorry to take your time.
No, no, my bad. Don't work too hard.
(Sleeping in today was a big no-no. Well, off to the batting center.)
(Down to 217 yen... The batting center's my only hope now. Let's scoot up Tsumugi Street.)
When'd you start borrowing from that loan shark?
Loan shark? You mean Takasugi-san?
Uh, it would've been around when he first got to Kineicho. So around a year ago?
You do know the crazy rumor about him, don't you?
You mean like how he's connected to the Nagoya Family?
That would be it.
Are they really that dangerous?
Well yeah. They're yakuza, dummy.
Have you ever seen any of these Nagoya Family people?
Not me personally.

Same. It's been fifteen years since I came to Kineicho, where
this family supposedly operates...
But no one here looks remotely yakuza-like.
Keep your voice down! They gotta be out there somewhere.

They say a soba delivery man stumbled into their office by
mistake. Next thing he knows, the poor guy's missing an eye.
Basically, people say they're the real law around these parts.
Borrow money from a guy connected to them, and you might seriously wind up dead.
Oh? Uno-san, is that concern in your voice I hear?
What do you expect? If you kick the bucket, there goes my 30,000 yen!
Hey, I'll pay it back someday!
Not someday, today!

Listen up, a new girl joined my favorite parlor today.
And I wanna be the first to savor her flavor!
Is that maybe... Julia-chan at Shachihoko Musume?
Aha, leave it to the sleuth of the sex industry!
You sure like your amateurs, don't you?
But you know, she used to be Nanako-chan at Madd Maxx.
Huh!? <Italic>That</Italic> old hag?
All she did was change venues and her professional name.
Get outta here!
Hey, not what I meant!
Oh, crap. Forgot about you.
Where's my thirty grand!?

Can't it wait? If I don't submit this story, I won't get a
single yen of what I eventually plan on paying you!
I'd say you don't mean to pay me back at all!
That's not true. I was gonna make a beeline for you as soon as I got my article fee.
Bet you told that to the loan shark too.
Ergh.
Bingo. Now I'm gonna walk you to work so you can't slip away.
...For real?
(Ahh... I just love me an <Italic>in-depth interview</Italic>! This article's gonna be a banger for sure!)
(No time to gloat, though. The publisher's waiting! Going down Kume Boulevard should be the quickest way.)

(Okay, the interview's finally about to happen. Back to
Club Futo Momo, posthaste!)
Hey, sis? Yup, Shinada-san bailed me out. Uh-huh. Thanks!
My sister says she'll be on her way to the market.
Market? Oh, right, her job.
Whew... Now I can do the interview.
Shinada-san, you're her manager, right?

She won't tell me which supermarket she works at,
so can you tell me? I'd like to swing by and give you
proper thanks.
Aw, no, you don't gotta do that! We're good, man.
Are you sure? Then, thank you very much.
She's the best sister in the world. So please keep looking after Mieko!
(Kubota Security. This is it.)

(This is Icho Street, so Kubota Security must be...
That way? Man, what a day this turned out to be.
Should've just stayed in bed!)
Gwargh!
Okay, now will you please bring Toriyama-san?
You're Toriyama-san? Milky⑬uh, your sister⑬told me you were in trouble.
My sister!?
You came to fix the mess this guy made? What a stand-up guy you are.

So I heard Toriyama-san broke something while on duty,
and now there's a liability issue?
Correct. And I assume you're here to cover all the damages?

About that. It shouldn't be the employee's responsibility.
Isn't that what company insurance is for?
Maybe if it was just once.

This numbnut screwed up so many times, I could fertilize
a farm with all the shit the boss gives me.
And this is the thanks I get. He's really gone and done it now.
His ass ain't the kind insurance just can wipe.
And if he can't pay compensation, he'll just have to borrow from a loan shark.
So what's this thing he broke?
Huh? What is this?
The bat that Koji Kakegawa, the Japanese home run king, used to set the world record.
It was on its way to the Baseball Hall of Fame... until I dropped it.
So what's it gonna be? Ya payin' for the damages or what?

This ain't some kinda toy you can find in the kiddie aisle
of some mom and pop shop.
Well, I can't pay, but...
Hey, hey! What the fuck do you think⑬
Toriyama-san, this is no big deal.
Oh, can you fix it somehow?
Don't have to. It's fake.
Oh, and how the fuck would you know, huh?
Because Kakegawa-san played with compressed bats.
What's a compressed bat?

They were banned in 1981, so you'll never see a pro go
busting one out...
But in his day, this would've been compressed.
